race.comment: GAMBLER (8) goes on top again after a brave win here last start, edging out the in-form Jimmy's Brother. His 1000m record is strong, he is proven here, and the Bruce have him humming. SHAKO (3) looms the main danger and boasts a terrific record here over the track and trip. Made an encouraging return back in July but hasn't quite gone on with it yet. Thompson taking over suggests he's worked well at home.  CHALICE WELL (5) comes through two strong form races and sets up a treat third-up with the 3kg claimer on. Win won't shock. CAPITAL HEART (1) is having his first run since May 22. Goes very well when fresh with three wins from six starts, the latest over 1100m at Ipswich at the start of last prep. Ran sixth in a trial at Doomben over 1000m recently. Sound prospects.
